LeaveRequest.title: Leave request
LeaveRequest.description: An employee request for leave (verlofaanvraag): a period of holiday, sick, unpaid, special, care or parental leave submitted for manager approval. The request lifecycle (draft → submitted → approved/rejected, with the shared no-self-approval separation-of-duties guard) is fully declarative per ADR-031, mirroring the Timesheet and Expense workflows. Leave is the HR/labour surface the portaliq fleet review flagged as missing in hrmq; external employees create and track these requests through the shared external portal (ADR-046), while approval stays a back-office manager action.

submit.description: The employee submits the leave request for manager approval. A rejected request may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the submitted leave request. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the requesting employee).

reject.description: A manager rejects the submitted leave request (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct the request and re-submit.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee domain object who requests the leave (the requester) — a domain-object reference, never a Nextcloud user id (ADR-046 A4). Drives the self-approval guard and scopes the portaliq external-employee view.

leaveType.title: Leave type
leaveType.description: The kind of leave requested, aligned with Dutch HR practice (Wet arbeid en zorg / BW 7): holiday (vakantie), sick (ziekteverlof), unpaid (onbetaald verlof), special (bijzonder verlof), care (zorgverlof), parental (ouderschapsverlof).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day of the requested leave period (ISO 8601 date).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day of the requested leave period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: Optional total number of leave hours requested — for partial-day leave or when the leave balance is administered in hours rather than days.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional free-text motivation for the request (e.g. the occasion for special leave).

status.title: Status
status.description: Approval workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (draft → submitted → approved/rejected).

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee submitted the leave request for approval.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: User ID of the manager who approved (or rejected) the leave request. Must differ from the requesting employee (no self-approval).

approvedAt.title: Approved at
approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval or rejection.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Reason the manager rejected the leave request, shown to the employee so it can be corrected and re-submitted.
